{"consolidated_memory":"RECURRING ISSUE: Missing step in funnel report (analytics/dashboards/funnel.py)

Component: analytics/dashboards/funnel.py (Python stack)
Test coverage: tests/analytics/test_funnel.py

Common pattern across all occurrences:
- Problem: missing step in the funnel report
- Reproduction: build the funnel for a two-week window
- Signal: a stage with zero users appears between two populated stages

THREE SEPARATE OCCASIONS:

OCCASION 1 [2026-04-15]:
- Trigger: only manifested for tenants with more than 10,000 distinct keys
- Root cause: mutable default argument shared across calls
- Fix: made the default empty and built the value per call
- PR #2934, branch fix/missing-step-1
- Result: backlog cleared 90 minutes after deploy

OCCASION 2 [2026-07-16]:
- Trigger: only manifested for jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- Root cause: cache entry that was never invalidated on write
- Fix: invalidated the entry inside the write transaction
- PR #5970, branch fix/missing-step-2
- Result: alert stayed quiet for 56 consecutive days

OCCASION 3 [2026-08-19]:
- Trigger: only manifested for sessions that arrived through the OAuth provider
- Root cause: schema drift between the migration and the model
- Fix: regenerated the model from the migration and pinned the checksum
- PR #8451, branch fix/missing-step-3
- Result: job finished in 66 minutes instead of 5 hours
- Note: same corner of analytics/dashboards/funnel.py as earlier missing step work; context carried over"}
